name: Ochre Jelly

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Split
traits.description: When the jelly is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage, it splits into two new jellies if it has at least 10 hit points remaining. Each new jelly has hit points equal to half the original jelly's, rounded down. New jellies are one size smaller than the original jelly.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Acid damage.

description: Ochre jellies are amorphous acidic oozes that squeeze through cracks and doorways alike, splitting into hungry duplicates whenever struck by a blade or bolt of lightning.
